title: Full-Body Strength & Conditioning
description: A 45-minute full-integration routine spanning strength, tendon, cardio-chain, and cuff work.
notes: Canonical Fable W3 routine from docs/research/draft-routines-v2.md.
Forty-five 40-second work intervals retain every following 20-second rest, including the final rest.
Only honest built-in GIF matches are visual; all other movements deliberately use text fallback.
safetyCues: No jumping anywhere; swings and snatches use planted feet with no heel pop.
For every floor or plank movement, use knees-down or hands-elevated regressions; fists do not unload the first MTP.
For deep lunge or split work, keep the rear instep flat and shorten the stance rather than forcing the great toe.
For calf loading, use 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down, never start a routine with calf raises, never bounce, target pain 0–3/10 with 5/10 as the ceiling, and require symptoms to settle by next morning.
Press with a neutral grip, never behind the neck, and stop on shoulder apprehension.
Strength stations target RPE 8 (occasional 9 on stable stations); isometric strength holds target RPE 8; calf loading is about RPE 8 within pain rules.
Swings, snatches, and shadowboxing target RPE 6–7; slow kicks and balance target RPE 5–7; cuff, short-foot, and low-load hip-control work targets RPE 5–7.
Every routine includes at least one weighted calf pair, one lateral-hip station, and one foot or cuff station.
Warm-ups run at least 6 minutes in 30-minute routines; ankle prep is always pumps plus heel-to-toe rocks, not calf raises, which are reserved for later stations.
The 45-minute routine carries both knee-angle calf pairs, psoas work, and cuff clusters.
The final interval's 20-second rest is retained so the routine duration is exactly 45:00.
